help.mission: Our mission is to democratize artificial intelligence education by creating tactile, visual, and multimodal learning experiences that empower kids, students, and professionals to build strong mental models of AI.
help.modesBody: Choose your journey on your first visit, or switch anytime from the sub-header toolbar on the Home page or lessons: Kids (8–14) with Chip's Trail, Plain English with everyday workplace analogies, or Standard canonical depth.
help.module1Body: Vote on mystery dialogues and slide open the curtain to spot the bot!
help.module2Body: Sweep dust off solar panels and watch if-then rules fix the rover!
help.module3Body: Drop apples & lemons onto the scale to make the neuron fire!
help.module4Body: Draw pixel cats and rockets; slide 3×3 convolution filters live!
help.module5Body: Solve word vector equations in a glowing 2D galaxy space!
help.module6Body: Balance applicant data and watch the scale level out!
help.privateBody: Running a local AI model means your questions and data never leave your computer. You don't need any API key, internet connection, or paid subscription!
help.readAloud: Read Aloud: Tap any speaker icon or the floating audio bar to hear Chip, Nova, or Prof. Alan narrate with real-time glowing sentence tracking.
help.step1Body: Visit the official Ollama website to download the installer for macOS, Windows, or Linux:
help.step2Body: Open your terminal and start the background Ollama runner:
help.step3Body: In a second terminal window, pull any of these fast, lightweight models:
help.step4Body: Click ⚙️ Settings in the top navigation, select the Local Ollama preset button, and click Save Settings. You are now 100% self-hosted!
